modal.title: Create new '{{name}}'

filename.label: Filename
filename.desc: ID pre-filled — type the name in front

modal.idWarning: ID {{id}} is not in the filename — it will be reassigned.
modal.errIdPropertyNotSet: ID property not set — could not locate file after template was applied (moved to unknown location?).

idTypes.heading: ID types
idTypes.desc: Each entry creates a command in the command palette. New types are available immediately.

confirmRemove.title: Remove ID type?
confirmRemove.message: Really remove the ID type '{{name}}' and its settings? This cannot be undone.

mask.label: Mask
mask.desc: Prefix followed by "#" digit placeholders — e.g. "p####" creates p0001, p0002 …

idProperty.label: ID property
idProperty.desc: Optional frontmatter property for storing the ID, e.g. "id" — used during rebuild and file creation.

uidProperty.label: UID property
uidProperty.desc: Optional: frontmatter property that receives a new GEDCOM UID when a file is created. Leave empty to skip.

reference.name: Reference GEDCOM
reference.desc: GEDCOM file in the vault to compare against, e.g. the latest re-export from an online database. Leave empty to skip the comparison.

report.name: Check report note
report.desc: Path of the note the check report is written to. It is overwritten on every run.

livingYears.name: Living person threshold (years)
livingYears.desc: Persons without a death event who were born more recently are treated as living and are not exported.

gedcom.reportCreated: GEDCOM check report created ({{count}} persons in export scope)
gedcom.reportFailed: GEDCOM check report failed, see console

uid.noneMissing: All notes tagged #{{tag}} already have a UID.

confirm.title: Assign UIDs
confirm.message: {{count}} notes tagged #{{tag}} have no valid UID. Write a new UID into the property "{{property}}" of each?
